verdict.rationale: Rollbar documents an official stdio MCP server and a REST API that can list production error/critical items. Its OpenAPI spec covers Item and Occurrence resources, and item statuses and owners support triage. The evidence pack never shows a Rollbar issue-tracker integration that files bugs (only PagerDuty incidents and generic webhooks), so the tracker-filing leg is unsupported. missing for 10: documented issue-tracker integration (e.g. Jira/GitHub Issues) for filing bugs, explicit retrieval of stack traces through the API/MCP, an enumerated MCP tool list, independent or hands-on corroboration of agent workflows.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, an agent can pull my top production issues with stack traces via API or MCP, triage them, and file the real bugs into my tracker

citations.quote: Get the first page of items that are error or critical, in the production environment
This MCP server implements the `stdio` server type, which means your AI tool (e.g. Claude, Cursor) will run it directly
There are four statuses: Active, Resolved, Muted, and Archived.
Stack traces will contain the original source filename, line number, method name, and code coordinates
